policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Danish Foreign Ministry guidance expressly grants these Danish-passport short-visitor visa exemptions.
conditions: BA, XK and TN: up to 90 days. UA: up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
Ukraine's conflict-related travel and border conditions do not alter the recorded visa status. Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Bangladesh and Cambodia visitor visas issued at arrival
policies.summary: Current Danish Foreign Ministry guidance expressly identifies visitor visa-on-arrival routes for Danish citizens in Bangladesh and Cambodia.
conditions: BD: obtain online approval before travel, then the visa at arrival; this is preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa. The Danish guidance states a maximum 90-day stay. KH: a tourist visa can be obtained at arrival, for a maximum 30-day stay.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Bangladesh Visa on Arrival online approval
steps: Obtain the stated online approval before travel using the ordinary Danish passport.
Present the approval on arrival for the border-issued visa and comply with final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Danish visitor and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available from anywhere except the United States.
conditions: The source names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; an ordinary Danish passport holder without Cuban residency must obtain a tourist visa. Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel; the D'Viajeros declaration is separate.
The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension. Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Danish passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Danish ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Current Danish guidance requires Danish citizens to apply online before departure; Côte d'Ivoire's official ordinary-passport process prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: The route is for a valid ordinary passport. Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.

Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa. Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the ordinary Danish passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.
